items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: One man, Barbara, he was good.

ctx.x: Better than a tenor saxophone. Yeah, sure. Sure. Did they have any outstanding alto, those horn men?
Well, what I'm going to tell you, they had one, so far down, I think he put in the business now. One man, Barbara, he was good. Those fellows playing alto horn, mellophone.
Well, those fellows playing alto horn, mellophone, would they carry a melody like the baritone would sometimes?
